Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
Second Session
Meeting Number - 29
Federal Parliament of Nepal
Daily Business Schedule
Sunday, Ashadh 14, 2083
2:55 PM
Management Work
1. On behalf of the Right Honourable Prime Minister K.P. Sharma Oli, the Honourable Minister for Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs, Sobita Gautam, will present a proposal to "Consider the Public Procurement (Second Amendment) Bill, 2083".
2. The Honourable Minister for Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle, will present a proposal to "Consider the Prevention of Money Laundering (Third Amendment) Bill, 2083".
3. The Honourable Minister for Land Management, Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration, Pratibha Rawal, will present a proposal to "Consider the Cooperatives (First Amendment) Bill, 2083".
4. The Honourable Minister for Health and Food Security, Nisha Mehta, will present a proposal to "Consider the Bill to Amend Some Nepal Acts Related to Health Sciences Institute, 2083".
Condolence Motion
4. The Honourable Speaker will present a condolence motion on the passing of former member of the House of Representatives, Rajendra Kharel.

Panchan Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
